answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the trellis seed, the wharf timing is verifiable from the basalt record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 334 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 38 keys therefore burns 38 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
